title: A Part Library number over 50 characters is refused on an open part request
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding a part request for part A, not yet received, so part A sits on an open part request.
  • Use two new part numbers that no Part Library entry has, one exactly 51 characters long and one exactly 50 characters long.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with the 51-character number.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Wait 5 seconds.
  7. Replace the Part Number with the 50-character number.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  10. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • Part Number shows the 51-character number.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request.", with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."

Step 6:

  • The red message has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.

Step 7:

  • Part Number shows the 50-character number.

Step 8:

  • The save goes through, because only more than 50 characters is refused: the detail page shows the 50-character number.

Step 9:

  • The Work Orders list opens.

Step 10:

  • The part request on work order 1's line shows the 50-character number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-N7: “If the new number is longer than 50 characters and the part sits on an open part request, the save is refused with "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Rename over 50 characters with an open part request | "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
